title: Banana Bread
description: Banana Bread is a dish from United States prepared with banana, chicken egg, all-purpose flour, baking soda. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 5 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Beat the listed ingredients until pale and light; ensure butter and eggs are at room temperature when specified.
Gently fold in the remaining dry or wet ingredients just until homogeneous, without deflating the mixture.
Bake the shaped or assembled mixture in a preheated oven for about 55 minutes until set and cooked through.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 35 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
